lines.text: Josiah became king at eight years old, reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem, and did what was right to the LORD.
In his eighteenth year, Josiah sent Shaphan to have the money counted for buying timber and dressed stone.
Hilkiah the high priest told Shaphan he had found the Book of the Law in the king's palace.
Josiah sent five men to ask the LORD about the book, and they went to Deborah the prophetess in Jerusalem.
Because Josiah's heart was tender, the LORD said he would be gathered to his grave in peace.
